_readme: Upgrade steps for old seeds' slot_data, read by the apworld (slot_data_upgrade.py, Universal Tracker) and
embedded into the client DLL (ap_slotdata.cpp). Both apply the same steps, oldest version first, so code
only ever sees the current format. One entry per slot_data_version that needs one; each entry may have:
remapped: {key: [[old value, new value], ...]}  (pairs, since json object keys can only be strings)
added:    {key: value meaning the old behaviour}  (only when the key is missing)
Applied in that order (renamed, remapped, added, removed). Every new slot_data key needs an 'added' entry,
also Universal Tracker-only ones (check_compat.py fails otherwise). What data can't say (a changed meaning,
a split or merge) needs a new op, built in BOTH slot_data_upgrade.py and ap_slotdata.cpp.

2.note: 0.5.1: Fruit Filler (new option, off = 0.5.0); Extra Bells now in slot_data (0.5.0 seeds didn't say, its default)
